headline: Google DeepMind and Artificial Analysis introduce a benchmark for multimodal knowledge agents
summary: A Nov 10 technical report introduces the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark: 200 private, multi-file professional tasks spanning 10 sectors and 83 occupations, plus 10 disjoint public showcase tasks. The tasks require agents to combine visually dense files and often produce standalone deliverables. The authors evaluate four frontier models in a common Stirrup harness and report that removing image viewing lowered Gemini 4 Carbon’s Climb-WSR by 5.94 percentage points while increasing turns and output tokens. Reported quality differences among the top three models were statistically indistinguishable; model scores and cost estimates remain paper-reported.
